title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 0.31 (versions follow prime numbers), the creed: the code and Luma are the same as v0.19 (Luma's heart and the author's signature); this version closes the author's letter (CARTA-DEL-AUTOR.md) with his profession of faith, so that it is never lost. OS test suite: 402 passed, 0 failed. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v0.31: el credo — la carta del autor cierra eligiendo con el corazón lo que es real. Prototipo de investigación.
